role_and_message.evidence: The training architecture retains discovery of latent novel objects through frozen CLIP and knowledge self-distillation into the trainable detector.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: K-FPN/FPN two paths, RPN, proposal strips, RoI Align/RoI, two CLIP image-encoder roles, both text encoders and all embedding groups are retained.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All five loss/similarity labels, TE/IE definitions, parameter-state symbols, feature legends, object/base prompts and proposal check/cross markings remain.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Frozen CLIP branches to K-FPN/FPN; FPN features enter RPN; RPN proposals serve both pyramids. Novel proposals feed the teacher image encoder; RoI feature branches feed distillation, regression and category consistency. Original dashed loss associations remain at the source regions, although small crop seams affect continuity.

visual_encodings.evidence: Frozen snowflakes, trainable flames, no-learnable circles and orange/yellow/grey novel/base/background features match the original key.

examples_and_data.evidence: Thirteen protected source regions independently preserve photos, proposal marks, loss formulas, vectors and legends; listed exclusions remove only adjacent K-FPN/pyramid duplicate fragments and a partial duplicate label, all present in their proper positions.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Added discovery/self-distillation headings follow caption and Sections3.1–3.3, including generic foreground/background descriptions rather than novel class labels.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The final a2 legends no longer contain truncated neighboring modules; complete Base Categories label remains below the preserved class box. All relevant equations and loss labels are readable.

remaining_limitations: Original scientific scope retained. Source text and plot resolution remain a design limitation for blind scoring, not scientific-data rewriting.
